name: auriga-git-guards
description: Workflow guardrails for the git lifecycle: structural blocks on PR Ready transitions via both `gh pr ready` and `gh pr create` without `--draft`, a Conventional Commits title check on `gh pr create`, PR-body snapshot injection, and a commit-reminder hook that nudges agents at semantic boundaries.

interface.longDescription: Three hooks for the git lifecycle: commit-reminder nudges the agent to commit at semantic boundaries when uncommitted diff crosses size thresholds; pr-create-guard fetches the PR body + title after `gh pr create`, injects a body-snapshot reminder so the agent can self-verify the five-element PR description (scope / acceptance criteria / design decisions / risks / TODOs), and flags titles that don't match Conventional Commits with a soft nudge; pr-ready-guard hard-blocks structural problems (stray planning docs, unfinalized active specs, unpushed commits) at PR Ready transition — fires on BOTH `gh pr ready` AND `gh pr create` without `--draft`, so direct Ready-PR creation can't bypass the same checks. Bundles the git-workflow skill describing the full lifecycle. Designed for the auriga workflow in https://github.com/Ben2pc/auriga-cli.
